title: What Does Gumloop Pricing Cost per Workflow Run?
summary: Gumloop pricing plans combine a tier level with monthly credits, but the free plan now includes no credits at all.
body_markdown:
## When Activepieces is the better fit than Gumloop


Activepieces runs on your own infrastructure under an MIT-licensed core, bills 1 credit per flow run instead of per step, which means workflows cost the same regardless of complexity, and reaches 741 integrations counted from its open source monorepo.


If those are your requirements, they are the reasons to move; otherwise Gumloop's setup is quicker.


### Where the AI agent step runs across integrations


Activepieces is an open source automation platform, and its AI agent step can use the same[integrations (called pieces)](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces) that ordinary flows use. The library below lets you browse by category, from communication and commerce to developer tools, and sort by popularity.


That tells you the agent isn't confined to a short list of apps: the community directory of the[open source monorepo](https://github.com/activepieces/activepieces/tree/main/packages/pieces/community) holds 741 integrations, and if one exists for a tool, the agent can act in it, meaning you can likely automate across your entire existing tool chain.


Before committing, check the specific apps you depend on against that list. **Coverage of your own stack matters more** than the size of the catalog.


### Self-hosting and approval steps


Because the core is MIT-licensed and published in a[public GitHub repository](https://github.com/activepieces/activepieces/blob/main/LICENSE) , **you can run it on your own servers** and keep workflow data inside your network. That's the clearest reason to pick it over a hosted-only credit product.


If your security team asks where customer records are processed, you can answer directly.


For the same reason, approval steps matter. A flow can pause and wait for a person to sign off before the agent sends the email or updates the record. If a mistaken action is costly to reverse, that pause is cheaper than any cleanup afterward.


The Activepieces free plan carries 1,000 credits a month with unlimited flows, so you can run your own sample against it.


### Where Gumloop remains the simpler choice


If nobody on your team wants to maintain a server, self-hosting is a burden rather than a benefit. If your agent only drafts or analyzes and never acts on its own, approval steps add little.


And if you want one hosted product with AI built in from the start, Gumloop asks less setup of you, even though its credits need pricing out first.


If the first three needs describe you,[try Activepieces free](https://cloud.activepieces.com/sign-up?ap_cta=blog_body&ref=%2Fblog%2Fwhat-does-gumloop-pricing-cost-per-workflow-run) and compare the result with your credit estimate.
